core.title: Black Iron Swivel Hasp, Acorn ALCBP

text.description_html:
Acorn ALCBP, 4-1/2" Swivel Hasp

A hasp is a metal, hinged plate that fits over a loop that swivels to lock it in place. It can be paired with a padlock for added security. This is for light duty applications, such as closet doors, cabinets, and armoire doors. Keep your valuables away from prying eyes without spoiling the historic look of your antiques. The smooth black finish looks old world; it is perfect for historic and rustic decors--be it a ranch on the prairie, colonial style homes, or something even older.

Specifications of the Black Iron Swivel Hasp:

  • Material: Iron
  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Overall Length: 4-1/2"
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Package includes all mounting hardware.
